svg.text: polytini 0.1.4 against the fastest other library, every runtime and line length
Each cell: polytini's calls per second divided by the fastest of the 8 other libraries in that cell (named under the value). 1.0x is even, above is faster.
Default import, precision 5. Run of 2026-11-27 on an AMD Ryzen 7 5800X, Windows. 70 cells faster, 13 slower, 13 within the noise.
Within the noise: polytini was ahead in some rounds
and behind in others, so call it even

svg.text: "real" is the 1000 real-world lines, median 82 points. Each cell is the median of 5 interleaved rounds; between rounds a cell moved by a median of 5% to 7%, depending on the runtime.
googlemaps is @googlemaps/polyline-codec, mapbox is @mapbox/polyline, placemarkio is @placemarkio/polyline, pirxpilot is @pirxpilot/google-polyline. Every number is in docs/results.md.
